authority: Owner requested completion of remaining migration steps; PERFORMANCE PERF-03 allows a recorded safety/correctness trade-off with reason, measured cost and updated baseline. This is an explicit scoped engineering disposition, not a silent blanket waiver or stable-release approval.

fixed-admission-and-bounded-execution.reason: Retain descriptor/metadata/resource admission, envelope and entropy validation, cancellation/deadline checkpoints, asynchronous execution and owning-storage publication. The small absolute fixed cost dominates 361-pixel work. Tiny decode probes localise costs to validated parsing, guarded native decode and the public boundary; tiny RGB encoder and larger context controls corroborate the required execution/storage overhead. No safety guard is disabled.

checked-uint12-borrowed-input.reason: Retain fused little-endian/strided UInt12 loading with meaningful-precision validation and per-row cancellation into the required Float algorithm plane. Private native/context/shared/public controls localise the cost to bounded context and checked borrowed reads; public versus shared costs are small. Noise/mixed cases run the same loader as flat/ramp. The roughly pixel-proportional added cost is accepted to preserve correct sample interpretation and zero full-image handoff copies.

bounded-rgb-row-conversion.reason: Retain checked borrowed RGB reads and eight-row conversion scratch with joined, bounded workers and cancellation. Native/context/shared/public encoder controls localise the cost to bounded execution and row conversion; sequential and progressive encoders share this source-conversion path. The measured cost is accepted in exchange for bounded scratch and direct scoped source reads, rather than materialising a full packed source image.

environment: Native ARM64 Swift 6.4 release, stable normal battery power/settings, 66 power snapshots, all case thermal states nominal. No overlapping local codec build/fuzz/trace work. Raw load averages retained.
limitations: One developer host; no AC-powered or other-device performance inference.
Approximate paired bootstrap intervals are within-run descriptions, not population or multiple-comparison guarantees.
Private @testable code generation differs; diagnostic costs are not additive acceptance measurements.

Earlier 16–21% advisory chroma cost compares against uncorrected reconstruction. Correctness requires the new output; the controlled comparison uses the fixed predecessor with identical output. No claim that the correction is free versus the former incorrect path.
Future optimisations may reduce these costs while preserving validation, cancellation, precision and no-copy gates.
